answer: A trellis of signed task receipts holds each agent's score; weight decays weekly and only fresh, independently verified work restores it. Cloning a dormant identity inherits nothing but stale weight, rusting away like ferrous metal. Receipts bind to per-identity keys, so credentials cannot be replayed. Cost to the attacker: every fake node must genuinely work continuously to keep its score alive, turning sybils into free labor, each new identity a pigment drop that fades fast.
